retraction.reason: Retracted in M42 batch 15 under brief §1: the record earns no honest edge. The English article, at revision 1370623332, argues the war out of the Hispano-Moroccan war of 1859–1860, which ceded Sidi Ifni to Spain, and out of Moroccan independence in 1956 — "after Morocco achieved independence in 1956, it sought to claim Spain's remaining possessions in West Africa" — and forward to the Treaty of Angra de Cintra, the return of Ifni in 1969 and the Green March of 1975. None of the five is a record here. `french-conquest-of-morocco`, which batch 14 imported and which ends in 1937, is not mentioned. It waits on Moroccan independence in 1956.
